mainText: Good morning. Here is your market briefing for Thursday, October eighth. Futures are pointing lower. Dow futures are down roughly three quarters of a percent. S and P 500 futures are down about half a percent, and the Nasdaq 100 is down roughly three quarters of a percent. Oil is surging, with Brent crude above 104 dollars a barrel, as the White House weighs Iran strike options. The ten year Treasury yield is near five point three four percent, a more than two decade high. In premarket movers, Wolfspeed is up seventeen percent on a one point five billion dollar Defense Department loan. Applied Digital is up three percent on record revenue. PepsiCo is up two percent despite cutting its outlook. Broadcom is down about one percent on reports it is raising over fifty billion dollars for OpenAI chip deals. And chip stocks are weaker after a disappointing Samsung earnings report.
